title: rouse — interrogator

sentences.sentence: His banging roused the neighbours.
sentences.translation: 他重重的关门声把邻居都吵醒了。

sentences.sentence: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
sentences.translation: 我是沙仑的玫瑰花（或作水仙花），是谷中的百合花。

sentences.sentence: Janine looked at her coldly.
sentences.translation: 雅尼娜冷冷地看着她。

sentences.sentence: Don't gloat,the same misfortune may happen to you one day.
sentences.translation: 不要幸灾乐祸，说不定同样的不幸会落到你的头上。

sentences.sentence: Yet, in announcing the news to the United States and the world, Obama was careful not to gloat, as his predecessor George W Bush might well have done had the killing taken place under his watch.
sentences.translation: 然而，在向美国和世界宣布这个消息时，奥巴马却显的小心谨慎，没有表现出一点幸灾乐祸，因为他的前任乔治·布什任期内没有完成的事情被他完成了。

sentences.sentence: It is easy to gloat when the cool jock with the hot girlfriend wrecks his sweet car, especially if he seems kind of smug.
sentences.translation: 当酷酷的大学运动员和热辣的女友坐他的爱车失事后，特别是这人有些自以为是，那么幸灾乐祸的想法是很自然会产生的。

sentences.sentence: a solemn expression
sentences.translation: 严肃的表情

sentences.sentence: Their faces suddenly grew solemn.
sentences.translation: 他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。

sentences.sentence: a solemn procession of mourners
sentences.translation: 庄重的送葬队伍

sentences.sentence: Police managed to subdue the angry crowd.
sentences.translation: 警察设法控制住了愤怒的人群。

sentences.sentence: Napoleon subdued much of Europe.
sentences.translation: 拿破仑控制了大半个欧洲。

sentences.sentence: James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
sentences.translation: 詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

sentences.sentence: He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
sentences.translation: 他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

sentences.sentence: If mucus plugs became very watery, your phlegm would sometimes float upward unaided where it can be spit out.
sentences.translation: 如果堵塞住的黏液变稀，你的痰有时会自主向上朝着可以吐出来的方向浮动。

sentences.sentence: If you try it, bite or clip off the rind of the nut, then chew it like gum -- don't swallow it and be sure to spit out the juice, otherwise you're likely to get sick to your stomach.
sentences.translation: 如果你愿意尝尝的话，要先咬掉或者剪掉槟榔壳，然后像嚼口香糖一样咀嚼槟榔。 别咽下去，而且一定要把槟榔汁吐出来，要不然你的胃可能会不舒服。

sentences.sentence: If you happen upon a manzanita bush, chew the outer part of the fruit and spit out the hard seeds.
sentences.translation: 如果你碰巧看到石兰灌木，咀嚼其水果外边的部分，吐出里面坚硬的种子。

紫外检测器；紫外探测器
自动防火器；火焰检测器

sentences.sentence: a smoke detector
sentences.translation: 烟雾探测器

sentences.sentence: a metal detector
sentences.translation: 金属探测器

sentences.sentence: Most are traders lured by the cheapness and variety of goods made in the surrounding Pearl River Delta.
sentences.translation: 他们多是被珠江三角洲周边廉价和种类繁多的商品吸引过来的商人。

phrases.translation: 固有可靠性；本质可靠性

sentences.sentence: You must not  presume too much on the reliability of such sources.
sentences.translation: 你不应该过分指望这类消息来源的可靠性。

sentences.sentence: You have to work at it and design it in to your systems from the beginning, just like you have to design in scalability, performance, reliability and security.
sentences.translation: 您从一开始就得学习它并将其设计到您的系统中，就像您在可伸缩性、性能、可靠性和安全性方面进行的设计一样。

sentences.sentence: Therefore certainty is not only something of no use, but is in fact damaging, if we value reliability.
sentences.translation: 因此如果考虑可靠性的价值，确定性不仅仅没有用处，而且事实上还有害处。

sentences.sentence: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
sentences.translation: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

sentences.sentence: After some hesitation one of them began to speak.
sentences.translation: 犹豫了一会儿之后，他们中有一个人开口了。

sentences.sentence: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
sentences.translation: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

sentences.sentence: I've read this report carefully and I can vouch for its truthfulness.
sentences.translation: 我已仔细看过这份报告，我可以保证它的真实性。

sentences.sentence: I fired a hundred questions concerning the truthfulness of his statement.
sentences.translation: 我对他发言的真实性提出一连串质问。

sentences.sentence: The reporter raised a question touching the truthfulness of his statements.
sentences.translation: 记者对他发言的真实性提出疑问。

sentences.sentence: What is your surname?
sentences.translation: 你姓什么?

sentences.sentence: Your surname may be derived from a place, such as Lancaster, for example, or an occupation, such as Weaver, but this is not necessarily of relevance to your family history.
sentences.translation: 或许，你的姓氏来源于一个地方名，例如兰开斯特，或者来源于职业，例如编织工。 但是，这并不能中肯地说出你家族的历史。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 161 单元

rouse
音标：英 /raʊz/  美 /raʊz/
vt&n. 唤醒，觉醒
短语：rouse oneself — 奋起；振作精神
例句：His banging roused the neighbours.
他重重的关门声把邻居都吵醒了。

lily
音标：英 /'lɪlɪ/  美 /'lɪli/
n. 百合，百合花
短语：water lily — 睡莲；荷花
短语：day lily — [植]百合科萱草属植物（等于daylily）
短语：lily of the valley — 铃兰
短语：lily flower — n. [植]金针菜
短语：lily bulb — 百合粉末，百合
短语：calla lily — 马蹄莲；水芋
短语：tiger lily — [植]卷丹
短语：paint the lily — 画蛇添足
例句：I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
我是沙仑的玫瑰花（或作水仙花），是谷中的百合花。

coldly
adv. 冷淡地
例句：Janine looked at her coldly.
雅尼娜冷冷地看着她。

gloat
音标：英 /gləʊt/  美 /ɡlot/
n. 得意洋洋，幸灾乐祸
例句：Don't gloat,the same misfortune may happen to you one day.
不要幸灾乐祸，说不定同样的不幸会落到你的头上。
例句：Yet, in announcing the news to the United States and the world, Obama was careful not to gloat, as his predecessor George W Bush might well have done had the killing taken place under his watch.
然而，在向美国和世界宣布这个消息时，奥巴马却显的小心谨慎，没有表现出一点幸灾乐祸，因为他的前任乔治·布什任期内没有完成的事情被他完成了。
例句：It is easy to gloat when the cool jock with the hot girlfriend wrecks his sweet car, especially if he seems kind of smug.
当酷酷的大学运动员和热辣的女友坐他的爱车失事后，特别是这人有些自以为是，那么幸灾乐祸的想法是很自然会产生的。

solemn
音标：英 /'sɒləm/  美 /'sɑləm/
adj. 严肃的，庄重的
短语：solemn promise — 庄严承诺；誓言
短语：solemn ceremony — 隆重的典礼
例句：a solemn expression
严肃的表情
例句：Their faces suddenly grew solemn.
他们的脸突然变得严肃起来。
例句：a solemn procession of mourners
庄重的送葬队伍

subdue
音标：英 /səb'djuː/  美 /səb'du/
vt. 制伏
例句：Police managed to subdue the angry crowd.
警察设法控制住了愤怒的人群。
例句：Napoleon subdued much of Europe.
拿破仑控制了大半个欧洲。

jay
音标：英 /dʒeɪ/  美 /dʒe/
n. 松鸦
短语：jay chou — 周杰伦（中国台湾艺人）
短语：blue jay — [鸟]冠蓝鸦

habitual
音标：英 /hə'bɪtʃʊəl; -tjʊəl/  美 /hə'bɪtʃuəl/
adj. 习惯性的，经常的
短语：habitual abortion — 习惯性流产
短语：habitual residence — 通常住址；惯常居所
例句：James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

trustworthy
音标：英 /'trʌs(t)wɜːðɪ/  美 /'trʌstwɝði/
adj. 可靠的，信得过的
短语：trustworthy product — 信得过产品
例句：He is a trustworthy and level-headed leader.
他是个可信赖的、头脑冷静的领导。

spit out
吐出
例句：If mucus plugs became very watery, your phlegm would sometimes float upward unaided where it can be spit out.
如果堵塞住的黏液变稀，你的痰有时会自主向上朝着可以吐出来的方向浮动。
例句：If you try it, bite or clip off the rind of the nut, then chew it like gum -- don't swallow it and be sure to spit out the juice, otherwise you're likely to get sick to your stomach.
如果你愿意尝尝的话，要先咬掉或者剪掉槟榔壳，然后像嚼口香糖一样咀嚼槟榔。 别咽下去，而且一定要把槟榔汁吐出来，要不然你的胃可能会不舒服。
例句：If you happen upon a manzanita bush, chew the outer part of the fruit and spit out the hard seeds.
如果你碰巧看到石兰灌木，咀嚼其水果外边的部分，吐出里面坚硬的种子。

detector
音标：英 /dɪ'tektə/  美 /dɪ'tɛktɚ/
n. 探测器，检测器
短语：metal detector — 金属探测器
短语：gas detector — 气体检测器；瓦斯检查器；检气管
短语：infrared detector — 红外检测器
短语：smoke detector — 烟雾报警器
短语：fire detector — 火警探测器；爆炸性气体测定器
短语：flaw detector — 探伤仪；裂痕探测仪
短语：detector array — 探测器阵列；检波器组合
短语：flame ionization detector — 火焰离子化检测器；火焰电离检测器
短语：photoelectric detector — 光电探测器
短语：leak detector — 检漏器
短语：phase detector — 相位侦测器（等于phase discriminator）
短语：temperature detector — 测温器
短语：ultrasonic flaw detector — [工]超声波探伤仪
短语：edge detector — [机]边界检测器
短语：lie detector — 测谎仪
短语：uv detector — 紫外检测器；紫外探测器
短语：ultraviolet detector — [化]紫外光检测器
短语：current detector — 检流器
短语：flame detector — 自动防火器；火焰检测器
短语：photo detector — 光监测装置；光检器
例句：a smoke detector
烟雾探测器
例句：a metal detector
金属探测器

cheapness
n. 廉价
例句：Most are traders lured by the cheapness and variety of goods made in the surrounding Pearl River Delta.
他们多是被珠江三角洲周边廉价和种类繁多的商品吸引过来的商人。

reliability
音标：英 /rɪ,laɪə'bɪlətɪ/  美 /rɪ,laɪə'bɪləti/
n. 可靠性
短语：high reliability — 高可靠性；高可靠度
短语：reliability analysis — 可靠性分析
短语：system reliability — 系统可靠性
短语：reliability design — 可靠性设计
短语：reliability theory — 可靠性理论
短语：software reliability — 软件可靠性
短语：reliability test — [计]可靠性测试
短语：reliability engineering — 可靠性工程
短语：operational reliability — 使用可靠性
短语：reliability testing — 可靠性测试
短语：reliability growth — 可靠性增长
短语：safe reliability — 安全可靠性
短语：reliability prediction — [经]可靠性预计
短语：reliability estimation — 可靠性估算
短语：degree of reliability — 可靠程度
短语：mechanical reliability — 机械可靠性
短语：reliability allocation — 可靠性分配
短语：reliability coefficient — 可靠性系数
短语：reliability function — 可靠性函数
短语：inherent reliability — 固有可靠性；本质可靠性
例句：You must not  presume too much on the reliability of such sources.
你不应该过分指望这类消息来源的可靠性。
例句：You have to work at it and design it in to your systems from the beginning, just like you have to design in scalability, performance, reliability and security.
您从一开始就得学习它并将其设计到您的系统中，就像您在可伸缩性、性能、可靠性和安全性方面进行的设计一样。
例句：Therefore certainty is not only something of no use, but is in fact damaging, if we value reliability.
因此如果考虑可靠性的价值，确定性不仅仅没有用处，而且事实上还有害处。

detect
音标：英 /dɪ'tekt/  美 /dɪ'tɛkt/
vt. 发现，察觉，查明
例句：Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

hesitation
音标：英 /hezɪ'teɪʃn/  美 /,hɛzə'teʃən/
n. 犹豫，踌躇
短语：without hesitation — adj. 毫不犹豫的
例句：After some hesitation one of them began to speak.
犹豫了一会儿之后，他们中有一个人开口了。

latency
音标：英 /'leɪtənsɪ/  美 /'letnsi/
n. 潜伏，潜在
短语：latency time — 延迟时间，等待时间

instinct
音标：英 /'ɪnstɪŋ(k)t/  美 /'ɪnstɪŋkt/
n. 本能
短语：by instinct — 出于本能
短语：instinct for — 有…的天分；生来就
短语：on instinct — 本能，凭直觉
短语：killer instinct — 杀生本能
短语：maternal instinct — n. 母性本能
短语：animal instinct — 动物本能；野兽直觉
短语：basic instinct — 本能
短语：herd instinct — [心]群居本能，群体心理
例句：Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

truthfulness
音标：美 /'trʊθfəlnɪs/
n. 真实，正当
例句：I've read this report carefully and I can vouch for its truthfulness.
我已仔细看过这份报告，我可以保证它的真实性。
例句：I fired a hundred questions concerning the truthfulness of his statement.
我对他发言的真实性提出一连串质问。
例句：The reporter raised a question touching the truthfulness of his statements.
记者对他发言的真实性提出疑问。

surname
音标：英 /'sɜːneɪm/  美 /'sɝ'nem/
n. 姓
例句：What is your surname?
你姓什么?
例句：Your surname may be derived from a place, such as Lancaster, for example, or an occupation, such as Weaver, but this is not necessarily of relevance to your family history.
或许，你的姓氏来源于一个地方名，例如兰开斯特，或者来源于职业，例如编织工。 但是，这并不能中肯地说出你家族的历史。

interrogator
音标：英 /ɪn'terəʊɡeɪtə/  美 /ɪn'tɛrəɡetɚ/
n. 讯问者，质问者
